Unit 4 — The Enemy

A hunter with a memory: patrol, chase, attack, return. The unit ends with the full state machine drawn on paper and named in code — the biggest AP-algorithm idea of the semester, hidden in a guard with a leash.

Concepts this unit owns

The state machine pattern, normalized vectors, and the exam's algorithm definition — sequencing, selection, iteration — read directly out of EnemyController.cs. CED: AAP-1, AAP-2, AAP-3 (all three, in one script).
